about: Invented conformance cases for source passages. A reference is protected only when every support fragment is verbatim in one unit and the reference is marked useful; it is kept only when all of its fragments sit inside one passage. A qualified claim found in a passage must carry every qualifier with it. Forbidden text is a strengthened or reassigned reading that no passage may assert. Completions are the nomination answers, in request order.
